subject: LLM SDK observability contracts & gating — kickoff

From: Anna Lee <anna@promptforge.com>

Cc: ben@promptlabs.com
Date: 2027-11-18T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Proposal: observability contract + gating for LangChain/LlamaIndex integrations

Hi Evelyn,

Thanks again for taking time yesterday. PromptForge is ready to move forward on a standard observability agreement that covers SDK telemetry hooks and a conformance gate for tracing/metrics when customers use the LangChain and LlamaIndex connectors to our runtime.

High level asks from our side:
- A short "conformance" checklist (unit + integration tests) for SDKs that validate required spans/events and token attribution metadata.
- A timing SLA for ingestion of telemetry (e.g., tracing spans visible in our dashboard within X minutes).
- Agreed event schema (we attached a draft spec) so both sides can map connector events to our analytics.
- A joint acceptance process for the first two pilot customers.

I've attached a draft observability contract and a telemetry spec for the LlamaIndex adapter. Ben from PromptLabs is CC'd — he's offered to share a small reference harness for tracing that we can reuse.

Are you available for a 45-minute kickoff next week to align owners and an initial acceptance criteria matrix? Proposed slots: Tue/Wed morning PST.

Regards,
Anna Lee
Head of Platform Partnerships, PromptForge

Attachments: observability-contract-draft.pdf, llamaindex-telemetry-spec.md

I'll send a calendar invite for Wed and share a short agenda. Looking forward to aligning.

Best,

Evelyn / Anna — quick technical notes before the kickoff:

Top-level acceptance signals we should include in the conformance gate (suggested):
- Required spans: request.start, request.end, model.generate.chunk, cache.lookup, cache.hit, kv-cache.apply
- Token attribution: model.tokens.total, model.tokens.user_prompt (attach mapping for LlamaIndex document-resolution context)
- Trace sampling: default sample rate and a deterministic "customer-id" tag for cardinality control
- SLI targets for pilot: 95th-percentile token-gen latency below 400ms for short prompts (<=512 tokens) and end-to-end trace ingestion within 2 minutes.

Conformance test harness proposal:
- We can upstream a small Python pytest suite that exercises the LangChain connector and asserts expected span names/tags (we have a template used internally for Dedicated customers).
- For LlamaIndex, there are additional document-level spans (index.search, index.retrieval) that need canonical names — see included spec.

I'll prep a 1-page matrix before the meeting with concrete assertions and a small sample payload to run locally.

Marissa
Senior Engineering Manager, Integrations

All — thanks for the fast turn. I've uploaded a slightly updated telemetry spec and a sample pytest harness to the shared Drive link (see below) and attached the contract PDF with redlines for retention and PII language.

Quick answers to Redwood asks:
- Minimum retention: 90 days of span/metric data for pilot accounts; longer-term retention negotiable per-account (we note this in the contract).
- PII: telemetry will not include raw prompt content. PromptForge will request token attribution headers and redacted metadata (document_id hash, customer_id). KMS integration available on enterprise tier.
- Ingestion SLA: our ingestion pipeline typically surfaces spans in the UI within 90s; we'll document the worst-case 99th percentile observed in production (we estimate ~3 min under heavy load).

Next steps for kickoff: confirm attendees and I'll add Ben from PromptLabs to demo the harness.

Thanks,
Anna
